metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD 2.6.4 Loading Screens (GTA V Legacy)
metadata.description:
OPTIONAL: FBICat's GTA VI loading screens and start screen for the GTA VI-Inspired HUD, GTA V LEGACY (GTA5.exe). The HUD works without them: install this only if you want them. Install it with OpenIV, to the mods folder.
What it installs: FBICat's VI landing page and loading screens, with Rockstar's Vice City pictures, in update.rpf\x64\data\cdimages\scaleform_frontend.rpf (your mods folder's copy). To take them off again, put the game's own scaleform_frontend.rpf back (your install guide, "Optional: VI loading screens").
Fan-made and inspired by GTA VI. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. The pictures are from Rockstar's official GTA VI media and belong to Rockstar Games. No GTA VI game files are included. https://github.com/Geckomacabre/GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD
metadata.licence: Personal use. By FBICat. Contains art from Rockstar's official GTA VI media (property of Rockstar Games).
